Fig. 2. Heatmap of the PCC between affective labels and summary values of appraisal dimensions aggregated across all annotators. The sign (+) or (-) after each label denotes whether it is positive or negative, respectively. Dimensions are as follows: AR: arousal, CP: coping, GC: goal conduciveness, IP: intrinsic pleasantness, NV: novelty. The correlations shown represent the average between annotators for whom the correlation was significant (p < 0.05) after Bonferroni correction and of identical direction. Positive or negative direction is shown in blue or red, respectively. A correlation present for a single annotator was considered null.
